taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: sudo policy matching, delegated arguments and executable provenance
controls.source_trace: Resolve the exact matched command and who controls its executable, parameters, configuration and working-directory dependencies.
controls.implementation_branch: Apply the installed sudo version matching rules to the exact executable and arguments before analyzing helper behavior. Wildcards, regular expressions, environment controls and writable executable/parent paths have distinct implications. A matcher granting a command is expected when policy intends it; the defect is an unauthorized semantic effect reachable through that permitted helper.
controls.operational_method: Retain installed sudo version, effective includes/order/tags, RunAs identity, canonical executable and how that version matches the command argument string. Resolve wildcard versus supported regex semantics rather than assuming shell argv matching. Inspect writable executable/parent paths, permitted environment and helper dependencies. A local argv recorder proves arguments only; validate the actual sudo matching decision from supplied policy/output or an isolated policy fixture before attributing the helper semantic effect.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an isolated local policy fixture or inert argv-recording stub under owned identities; do not execute privileged escape payloads.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A sudo entry is intentional delegation; demonstrate unintended authority beyond its actual command and argument contract.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Constrain the delegated operation and mutable inputs, verifying authorized commands and rejected argument/environment changes.
